scenes.text: Imagine crying out for help, but your voice is on a unique frequency that literally nobody else on Earth can hear, which is the tragic reality for the loneliest whale in the world.

For decades, scientists have tracked this single, mysterious creature wandering the vast Pacific Ocean, completely isolated because while normal whales communicate at fifteen hertz, this giant sings at fifty-two hertz.
To other ocean life, its calls are completely silent, meaning it travels thousands of miles every year, singing into the dark, empty blue, waiting for a response that will never come.
Would you survive in total isolation like this, so tell me in the comments what you think this whale is searching for, and follow for more deep sea mysteries.
